title: CmdPal: Icons (8/n) - Add icon protocols and defer app icon extraction
summary: The fork review found five fallback-correctness issues in the new app-icon protocol path. Current-head general review comments are ready for failed jumbo lookups, candidate ordering, unusable prepared fallbacks, loading placeholders, and terminal generic fallback.

status.label: Review comments ready
status.detail: Five general review notes are pinned to the current upstream head.

next_action: Review and selectively post the drafted request-changes comments.

proposed_comments.title: Do not treat failed jumbo shell lookups as successful icons
proposed_comments.body:
### Do not treat failed jumbo shell lookups as successful icons

**Severity:** `high`

When SHGetFileInfo fails for a jumbo candidate, ThumbnailHelper.GetLargestIcon can still use the zero-initialized image-list index and return an unrelated system icon. That makes a missing primary candidate look successful and prevents valid later fallbacks from being tried. Please return IntPtr.Zero/null when the shell lookup fails, and cover the missing-primary jumbo path.

proposed_comments.title: Preserve app-icon candidate order across thumbnail and ordinary icon parsing
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve app-icon candidate order across thumbnail and ordinary icon parsing

**Severity:** `high`

The processor tries thumbnail extraction for every candidate before allowing the loader to parse an earlier candidate as an indexed icon, URI, or glyph. A later executable thumbnail can therefore win before an earlier explicit candidate is evaluated. Please process each candidate in order: try the appropriate thumbnail path, then ordinary icon conversion/materialization for that same candidate before moving to the next fallback.

proposed_comments.title: Continue past unusable prepared fallback candidates
proposed_comments.body:
### Continue past unusable prepared fallback candidates

**Severity:** `high`

Fallback resolution currently stops once a candidate can be syntactically prepared, even if it cannot produce an icon. Missing local file URIs, non-image shell/protocol URIs, binary references with no bitmap, and the invalid-glyph marker can all suppress a later valid fallback. Please validate prepared fallback candidates before accepting them and continue to the next ordered candidate when the prepared value is not usable.

proposed_comments.title: Keep the generic app icon visible while deferred app icons load
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep the generic app icon visible while deferred app icons load

**Severity:** `medium`

Replacing the Installed Apps row icon immediately with an unresolved protocol request can leave cold rows blank, or make a virtualized row keep a recycled icon until the async request completes. Please publish GenericAppIcon as the immediate row/command placeholder and swap in the protocol request only after the deferred load starts.

proposed_comments.title: Add the generic app glyph as the terminal app-icon fallback
proposed_comments.body:
### Add the generic app glyph as the terminal app-icon fallback

**Severity:** `medium`

For apps whose IcoPath/ExePath candidates cannot produce an icon, the protocol request can still resolve to an empty icon source and replace the generic placeholder with a blank row or hero image. Please append the existing generic app glyph as the terminal candidate for both row and jumbo/hero app-icon requests, and add regression coverage for the exhausted-candidate case.

review.body: Thanks for continuing the CmdPal icon-loading series. I found several fallback correctness issues in the new app-icon protocol path that should be addressed before merging: missing candidates can stop ordered fallback resolution, deferred rows can lose their generic app placeholder, and ordinary invalid candidates can be accepted before later valid fallbacks.

judgment.rationale: The current upstream delta introduces five reproducible app-icon fallback failures. Fork-only fixes resolved each issue, all Copilot threads were closed, and focused builds and tests passed.
evidence: A failed jumbo SHGetFileInfo lookup can use image-list index zero and return an unrelated icon.
The processor attempts all thumbnail candidates before ordinary parsing, violating documented candidate order.
Syntactically prepared but unusable candidates can suppress later valid fallbacks.
Deferred Installed Apps icons can lose the immediate generic placeholder.
Exhausted app-icon candidates can replace the placeholder with an empty source.
Focused UI, Apps, toolkit, and module-interface builds passed.
Focused tests passed across 36 UI, 8 Apps, and 22 toolkit cases.
The final fork audit found zero unresolved Copilot threads.
judgment.recommended_action: After explicit maintainer approval and a current-head freshness check, post the selected comments as a request-changes review.
